title: Sources: Meta plans to debut two Ray-Ban smart glasses models next week intended for prescription wearers, to be sold mainly via prescription eyewear channels (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)
summary: Mark Gurman / Bloomberg: Sources: Meta plans to debut two Ray-Ban smart glasses models next week intended for prescription wearers, to be sold mainly via prescription eyewear channels — Meta Platforms Inc. plans to debut two new Ray-Ban smart glasses models next week intended for prescription wearers.
